description: Defines the Coverage class implementing API coverage functionalities, interfacing with channel objects to start and stop JavaScript and CSS coverage recording.

classes.name: Coverage
classes.description: A class providing methods to start and stop JavaScript and CSS coverage recordings through a channel.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Coverage class with a channel object.

methods.name: startJSCoverage
methods.description: Begins JavaScript coverage collection with optional parameters.

methods.name: stopJSCoverage
methods.description: Stops JavaScript coverage collection and returns the coverage entries.

methods.name: startCSSCoverage
methods.description: Begins CSS coverage collection with optional parameters.

methods.name: stopCSSCoverage
methods.description: Stops CSS coverage collection and returns the coverage entries.
